name: Clergy Ring
description: (Tag:holy)(Tag:magic)An angel-blessed ring gaining 1 charge every 8 hours up to 3, each activating one effect: 1: Smite - charges fists or held weapon with holy energy for the next strike. 2: Blessing - boosts one chosen physical stat for 5 minutes. 3: Purify - cures afflictions with strength scaling with user energy.
